user.title: Connect Pack-In
user.description: Approve this Home Assistant in the Pack-In phone app. The linking account needs Premium. Every member controls whether their location is shared with this home.

pair.title: Approve on your phone
pair.description: In Pack-In, open Settings → Connected homes → Connect a home. Enter **{code}**, select a Pack and review its permissions. Then select Submit here. This code expires after 5 minutes. Connection fingerprint: {fingerprint}.

error.unavailable: Pack-In could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.approval_pending: Approval is still pending. Approve this home in Pack-In first.

abort.pairing_expired: The code expired. Start setup again.
abort.pairing_denied: This pairing was denied or has already been used.
abort.wrong_pack: Choose the same Pack when reconnecting this entry.

init.title: Find Me
init.description: One shared location request per Pack at this interval. Disabled stops location retrieval. Tasks, groceries and calendar use a shared real-time connection.
